units.source_text: 她的衣著虽带几分艺妓的打扮，

en.t: Her clothing had something of a geisha look about it,

units.source_text: 可是衣服下摆并没有拖在地上，而且只穿一件合身的柔软的单衣。

en.t: but the hem of her kimono did not trail on the floor, and she wore only a soft, well-fitting unlined robe.

units.source_text: 唯有腰带很不相称，显得很昂贵。

en.t: Only her sash seemed out of place, looking very expensive.

units.source_text: 这副样子，看起来反而使人觉得有点可怜。

en.t: This appearance somehow made her seem rather pitiable instead.
